prompt_edits: are the module's own declared choices, and nothing else is looked up.

are the module's own declared choices, and nothing else is looked up. The crude chain takes a specific gravity at 60 F of 141.5 / (131.5 + API) against the declared reference water of 999 kg/m3, thinned by 0.0007 per degree C above a reference temperature of 15.56 C.
lesson_edits: and the result is then thinned by temperature at a declared rate of 0.0007 for each degree.

The thinning is measured from a reference temperature of 15.56 C, which is 60 F taken to two decimals, so the whole chain is 141.5 / (131.5 + API) x 999 x (1 - 0.0007 (T - 15.56)) with T in C. Use 15.56 exactly: the unrounded 60 F, 15.5556 C, moves a density by a few thousandths of a kg/m3.
